"""Synthetic agent tests (after the fix loop)."""
import pytest

from inventory import Depot, DepotError


def make(cash=100_000):
    d = Depot(["A", "B"], {"A": 500, "B": 500}, cash, rounding_mode="ROUND_HALF_EVEN")
    d.add_item("BOLT", 12, 50)
    d.add_item("GLUE", 240, 5, shelf_life_days=7)
    return d


def test_C01_duplicate():
    with pytest.raises(DepotError):
        make().add_item("BOLT", 12, 50)


def test_C02_unknown_sku():
    with pytest.raises(DepotError):
        make().receive("NOPE", 1, "A")


def test_C04_receive_and_capacity():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 10, "A")
    assert d.stock("BOLT", "A") == 10
    with pytest.raises(DepotError):
        d.receive("BOLT", 600, "A")


def test_C05_cost():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 10, "A")
    assert d.cash == 100_000 - 120


def test_C06_insufficient_stock():
    d = make()
    with pytest.raises(DepotError):
        d.ship("BOLT", 1, "A", 10)


def test_C07_ship_adds_cash():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 10, "A")
    c = d.cash
    d.ship("BOLT", 5, "A", 16)
    assert d.cash == c + 80


def test_C08_list_price():
    assert make().list_price("BOLT") == 16


def test_C09_bulk_discount():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 60, "A")
    c = d.cash
    d.ship("BOLT", 20, "A", 10)
    assert d.cash == c + 180


def test_C10_transfer():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 10, "A")
    d.transfer("BOLT", 4, "A", "B")
    assert (d.stock("BOLT", "A"), d.stock("BOLT", "B")) == (6, 4)


def test_C13_expiry():
    d = make()
    d.receive("GLUE", 2, "A")
    for _ in range(8):
        d.advance_day()
    assert d.stock("GLUE") == 0


def test_C14_reorder():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 60, "A")
    d.ship("BOLT", 15, "A", 16)
    assert ("REORDER", "BOLT", "A") in d.notifications()


def test_C16_C15_orders():
    d = make()
    o = d.place_order("S1", "BOLT", 1, 5)
    d.deliver(o, 5)
    assert d.reliability("S1") == 4


def test_C25_stock_total():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 3, "A")
    d.receive("BOLT", 4, "B")
    assert d.stock("BOLT") == 7


def test_C26_report():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 2, "A")
    assert d.report() == [("BOLT", "A", 2, 24)]


def test_C28_save_load():
    d = make()
    d.receive("BOLT", 2, "A")
    s = d.save()
    d.receive("BOLT", 2, "A")
    d.load(s)
    assert d.stock("BOLT") == 2


def test_C29_sim_same_seed():
    from sim import simulate
    assert simulate(5, 1) == simulate(5, 1)


def test_C31_constructor():
    assert make().cash == 100_000
